svg.title: VANTAGE — SPATIAL WEBXR, 3DGS RECONSTRUCTION & REAL-TIME VOICE ARCHITECTURE
svg.desc: Vantage turns field photos into room and dish Gaussian splats and renders them in a four-scene PlayCanvas app. The chart shows direct and multipart uploads, reconstruction with Atlas and TRELLIS, the Fastify gateway, SQLite and optional Postgres storage, procedural Boston station dioramas, and OpenAI Live voice tools for the WebXR and desktop or mobile surfaces.

g.text: SPATIAL WEBXR, 3DGS RECONSTRUCTION & REAL-TIME VOICE ARCHITECTURE
BostonHacks 2026 · Meta Quest 3 + Web + Contribute PWA · 2026-11-22
FIELD CAPTURE & DUAL-ENGINE 3D GAUSSIAN SPLAT PIPELINE
in a touch-driven flat SVG interface.
Manual selection for room and dish sets.
Direct PUT of frames + frames.json to private
Dishes and Studio. EXIF orientation and
World Labs Atlas API v2 · 2–32 photos
Camera pose + depth → SPZ. Splat step
Download on success, before 1 h expiry¹.
SOG compression and native PLY / SPZ
with optional CDN. Local builds are served
queued → generating → downloading → converting → needs_review → ready
PROCEDURAL CITY COMPILER, FASTIFY GATEWAY & REAL-TIME AGENT
Pinned MBTA stops + modeled route paths
glTF 2.0, PLY and JSON · 31 validated exports
Physical props, anchors and track geometry
30+ REST, SSE & WebSocket routes · per-IP limits · server-side provider keys
Catalog · pipeline · captures · MBTA · Live · Realtime · pairing · admin
Vehicles 5 s · predictions 10 s · alerts 60 s
27 client tools · scenes, filters, tray, camera,
dish rotation, highlights, transit and visit notes.
WEBXR SPATIAL RUNTIME, CUSTOM SHADERS & MULTI-DEVICE SURFACES
AR hit-test, plane and mesh detection.
25-joint GLB hands, pinch and forearm dock.
3D menu, review clipboards and dish physics.
Canvas textures redraw on content changes.
Paper Map dock · voice, upload, moderation.
SOG / SPZ / PLY · Zstd WASM for SPZ.
¹ Provider timings and expiry are documented. ² Standby and web search are requested when supported. Separate Realtime credential route: POST /api/realtime/session.

³ POST /api/pairing/create · WS /ws/pair/:code · open_place / send_trip. ⁴ Tracked demo files: 65 SOG, 2 PLY, 27 GLB. Map +X east, +Z south. Sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), BPDA, Cambridge GIS, MassGIS, MBTA.

⁵ Shell assets use cache-first and demo assets use network-first. Direct image PUT bypasses the API. SQLite runs the local catalog and worker. Optional Postgres tracks cloud captures and Vultr stores the binaries.
